Request: What is the cLogP of erlotinib?

Available tools:

- rdkit.descriptors(smiles) : Physico-chemical descriptors + QED + synthetic accessibility.

- rdkit.scaffold(smiles) : Bemis-Murcko scaffold (used for leakage-free splitting and diversity).
- rdkit.similarity(smiles_a, smiles_b) : Tanimoto similarity on Morgan fingerprints.
- rdkit.similarity_matrix(smiles_list) : Pairwise Tanimoto matrix; used by diversity selection and applicability domain.
- rdkit.validate_batch(smiles_list) : Validity / uniqueness report for a generated batch.
- chembl.status() : ChEMBL release and API availability.
- chembl.target_by_accession(accession) : Map a UniProt accession to ChEMBL targets (single-protein preferred).
- chembl.activities(target_chembl_id, limit) : Bioactivities for a target: exact-relation, pChEMBL-valued records only.
- chembl.molecule(chembl_id) : One ChEMBL molecule record (structure, properties, development phase).

- pubchem.compound_by_cid(cid) : Fetch one CID record.
- pubchem.synonyms(cid) : Depositor-supplied synonyms for a CID.
- uniprot.entry(accession) : Full UniProtKB record for an accession, reduced to the fields the agents use.
- uniprot.search_gene(gene, organism_id) : Resolve a gene symbol to reviewed UniProt accessions (human by default).
- uniprot.sequence_features(sequence) : Composition features computed locally from a sequence (no network).
- pdb.entry(entry_id) : Entry-level metadata: title, method, resolution, entity counts.
- pdb.download(entry_id) : Download the deposited PDB-format coordinates; returns a local path + sha256.
- pdb.ligands(pdb_path) : Bound ligands with atom counts and centroids, computed from the coordinate file.
- pdb.search_by_ligand_smiles(smiles, rows) : PDB entries whose co-crystal ligand matches a molecule, by chemical-structure se
- pdb.chemcomp(comp_id) : Chemical-component dictionary record for a ligand code (gives its SMILES).
- pdb.chain_sequences(pdb_path) : One-letter sequences per chain, read from SEQRES records.
- pdb.extract_receptor(pdb_path, out_path) : Write a receptor-only PDB (protein atoms, optional single chain, altloc A).
- pdb.extract_ligand(pdb_path, resname, out_path) : Write a single HET group to its own PDB (used as the redocking reference pose).
- alphafold.prediction(accession) : AlphaFold DB entry metadata for a UniProt accession.
- alphafold.download_model(accession) : Download the AlphaFold PDB model.
- alphafold.plddt_summary(pdb_path) : Per-residue pLDDT (B-factor column of CA atoms) summarised into confidence bands
- docking.vina_version() : Report the exact Vina build and its hash -- recorded with every docking claim.

- docking.pose_rmsd_all_models(reference_pdb, pose_pdbqt) : RMSD of every docked pose to the reference, decomposing sampling from scoring.
- docking.contacts(receptor_pdb, pose_pdbqt) : Geometric protein-ligand contacts (distance criteria only, not a PLIP-grade mode
- docking.pose_to_sdf(pose_pdbqt) : Convert one docked pose to SDF/PDB for viewing (Open Babel).
- hazard.screen(smiles) : Screen one structure; returns severity, matched motif names and the decision.
- hazard.screen_batch(smiles_list) : Screen a batch; used as a gate on every generated candidate set.
- pocket.detect(pdb_path, spacing) : Detect buried cavities on a protein surface.

- generators.brics_recombine(smiles_list, n) : G2: BRICS-fragment the supplied actives and recombine fragments into new structu

- admet.esol_logS(smiles) : ESOL-style aqueous solubility estimate. Literature linear form; see module docst
- admet.cns_mpo_like(smiles) : CNS-MPO-style desirability sum over six physicochemical properties (0-6).

- qsar.predict(model_path, smiles_list) : Predict pChEMBL with conformal intervals and an applicability-domain verdict.
- qsar.scaffold_split(smiles) : Assign whole Bemis-Murcko scaffolds to train or test (largest groups to train fi
